module origen_117150 #(
    parameter MDIO_CLK_DIV = 32
) (
    input wire clk,
    input wire rst_n,
    input wire ren,
    input wire wen,
    input wire [4:0] phy_addr,
    input wire [4:0] reg_addr,
    input wire [15:0] wdata,
    output reg [15:0] rdata,
    output reg rw_ready,
    output reg mdio_clk,
    inout wire mdio_io
);

    // States
    localparam IDLE = 3'd0;
    localparam PREAMBLE = 3'd1;
    localparam FRAME = 3'd2;
    localparam TURNAROUND = 3'd3;
    localparam DATA = 3'd4;
    localparam COMPLETE = 3'd5;

    reg [2:0] state, next_state;
    reg [5:0] clk_div_count;
    reg [5:0] bit_count;
    reg [63:0] frame;
    reg mdio_out, mdio_oe;
    reg [15:0] read_data;

    // MDIO clock generation
    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if (!rst_n) begin
            clk_div_count <= 0;
            mdio_clk <= 0;
        end else if (clk_div_count == MDIO_CLK_DIV - 1) begin
            clk_div_count <= 0;
            mdio_clk <= ~mdio_clk;
        end else begin
            clk_div_count <= clk_div_count + 1;
        end
    end

    // State machine
    always @(posedge mdio_clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if (!rst_n) begin
            state <= IDLE;
        end else begin
            state <= next_state;
        end
    end

    // Next state logic and output control
    always @(*) begin
        next_state = state;
        mdio_out = 1'b1;
        mdio_oe = 1'b1;
        rw_ready = 1'b0;

        case (state)
            IDLE: begin
                if (ren || wen) begin
                    next_state = PREAMBLE;
                    frame = {32'hFFFFFFFF, 2'b01, wen ? 2'b01 : 2'b10, phy_addr, reg_addr, wen ? 2'b10 : 2'b00, wen ? wdata : 16'h0000};
                    bit_count = 0;
                end
            end
            PREAMBLE: begin
                mdio_out = frame[63];
                if (bit_count == 31) begin
                    next_state = FRAME;
                    bit_count = 0;
                end else begin
                    bit_count = bit_count + 1;
                end
            end
            FRAME: begin
                mdio_out = frame[31-bit_count];
                if (bit_count == 13) begin
                    next_state = TURNAROUND;
                    bit_count = 0;
                end else begin
                    bit_count = bit_count + 1;
                end
            end
            TURNAROUND: begin
                if (wen) begin
                    mdio_out = frame[17-bit_count];
                end else begin
                    mdio_oe = 1'b0;
                end
                if (bit_count == 1) begin
                    next_state = DATA;
                    bit_count = 0;
                end else begin
                    bit_count = bit_count + 1;
                end
            end
            DATA: begin
                if (wen) begin
                    mdio_out = frame[15-bit_count];
                end else begin
                    mdio_oe = 1'b0;
                    read_data[15-bit_count] = mdio_io;
                end
                if (bit_count == 15) begin
                    next_state = COMPLETE;
                end else begin
                    bit_count = bit_count + 1;
                end
            end
            COMPLETE: begin
                rw_ready = 1'b1;
                if (!ren && !wen) begin
                    next_state = IDLE;
                end
            end
        endcase
    end

    // Output assignments
    assign mdio_io = mdio_oe ? mdio_out : 1'bz;

    always @(posedge mdio_clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if (!rst_n) begin
            rdata <= 16'h0000;
        end else if (state == COMPLETE && !wen) begin
            rdata <= read_data;
        end
    end

endmodule
